metadata.description: Every completed, topped-out and under-construction building 150 m or taller in 348 cities in the CTBUH database, located to its exact position and assigned to its district. Suburbs are merged into their metropolitan city and keep their own name as the district.
metadata.building_source: CTBUH / Council on Vertical Urbanism, The Skyscraper Center
metadata.coordinate_sources: CTBUH database coordinates; for the first 58 cities verified and refined against OpenStreetMap building footprints (© OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL); cities added in September 2026 checked by reverse geocoding (OSM via Nominatim/Photon); remainder geocoded or researched individually

coord_precision_values.building-verified: Point is the OSM footprint centroid of the tower, confirmed by a matching height and/or name
coord_precision_values.building: CTBUH database coordinate for the tower
coord_precision_values.building-geocoded: Geocoded to a named building matching the CTBUH address
coord_precision_values.complex: Point is the centre of the multi-tower complex the building belongs to
coord_precision_values.approximate: Street- or area-level only - not the building itself

metadata.shares_point_with: Number of OTHER towers in this file carrying the identical coordinate. Non-zero means a map should spiderfy/offset the markers so each tower stays clickable.
metadata.license: Building data © CTBUH; coordinates derived in part from OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL) - attribute both on any published map.
